name: 9409-batchdecode-qwen25-7b-1gpu
model: Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B -- the BASE model, not `-Instruct`, and DO NOT SUBSTITUTE IT. Ungated on the Hub, ~15.2 GB of bf16 weights in 4 shards.
hardware: 1x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3, one node, one GPU.
parallelism: tp1. No tensor, pipeline, expert or data parallelism; nothing is sharded across ranks.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=8, warmup the first 20%, bounded at 320 requests with a 2400 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, SINGLE TURN, no shared prefix, over `/v1/completions` and STREAMING. Prompts centred on 176 tokens (stdev 16, clamped 128-224); generations pinned at exactly 1024 tokens with no spread, guidellm setting `max_tokens` and `ignore_eos: true` so nothing stops early at EOS. `temperature: 0`, seed 42.
purpose: A long-form creative writing assistant generating 1024-token completions from short prompts for eight concurrent streaming users on one GPU.
launch:
# sglang at commit a91e90d9a3604118554b87b2078a513432fa361a (`git describe --tags` =
# v0.5.0rc2-103-ga91e90d9a36). The interpreter is named by `configs/env.yaml: venv`.
#
# Flat `key: value` only. A nested block is DROPPED by the flat parser, and the engine then
# starts without the setting this file declares.

model-path: Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B
tp-size: 1
attention-backend: flashinfer
context-length: 2048
mem-fraction-static: 0.85
random-seed: 42
